dataset_name: CycloneLM Curated Coastal Karnataka Domain Corpus

provenance.meteorology: India Meteorological Department (IMD) cyclone classification standards and public advisories
provenance.regional_geography: Government of Karnataka Coastal Disaster Management documentation
provenance.mcda_methodology: Thomas Saaty Analytic Hierarchy Process (AHP) open academic specifications
provenance.machine_learning_surrogate: Surrogate Logistic Regression architecture and non-downgrading safety invariant from Milestone 3A/3B
provenance.clustering: K-Means archetypes derived for Dakshina Kannada and Udupi (N=622 units)
provenance.safety_rules: Strict refusal to fabricate dynamic weather or live shelter occupancy
